row.reason: ResMed overlaps with Accendra in home sleep and respiratory care. Both serve patients managing these conditions at home, and ResMed also offers diagnostic tools to providers. ResMed develops devices and software, while Accendra delivers home medical equipment and supplies and educates patients and families. Accendra also serves diabetes, wound care, urology, and ostomy patients, so the overlap covers only part of its business.

T:P1.3.text: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise of peace of mind, a promise of confidence, and a commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

T:P1.4.text: Backed by the industry-leading expertise of our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health provides patients with critical products, services, and support to manage their health, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year.

T:P2.2.text: Healthcare is complicated. Accendra Health makes it a little easier by Bringing Care To Life ™.

T:P2.3.text: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise that gives healthcare professionals peace of mind that their patients can get the care they need. A promise offering confidence to people that they can manage their health and live life on their own terms. A commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

T:P2.4.text: With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials. We overcome obstacles. We educate and provide answers. We make it possible for patients and families to access healthcare when and where they need it, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year who receive care at home.

T:P2.5.text: Healthcare is complicated, but Accendra Health is here to help make it a little easier. We focus on the details of bringing care into the home, empowering patients with critical products, services, and support so they can focus on the moments that matter most.

T:P2.6.text: At Accendra Health, our Purpose drives us. Bringing Care To Life ™ means meeting people where they are and delivering care that fits their lives beyond traditional settings.

T:P2.7.text: Our Mission is to provide innovative solutions that ensure patients get the care they need in the comfort of their homes.

T:P2.8.text: Our Vision is to be a leading partner in care for medical equipment, supplies, and solutions in the home for individuals, families, and caregivers.

C:P2.1.text: Sleep Apnea Test at Home | Home Sleep Testing Solutions

C:P2.2.text: NightOwl is a small, efficient sleep apnea test at home that offers 10 nights of recorded data for internight variability and an alternate to in-lab sleep tests

C:P2.3.text: Resmed diagnostic solutions are designed to help the millions of undiagnosed sleep apnea patients get answers they need, and the treatment they deserve so they can rest. Our Home Sleep Tests (HSTs) empower providers to screen more patients and manage each step of the diagnostic process.

C:P2.4.text: Fully disposable, non-invasive home sleep test – fits comfortably on a patient’s index finger

C:P2.5.text: Records up to 10 nights of data † to help provide an accurate picture of a patient’s sleep health

C:P2.6.text: Comes with an easy-to-follow companion app, myAir, that helps patients through each testing step

C:P2.7.text: Cloud-based home sleep test that automatically syncs patient data each morning to the provider portal

C:P2.8.text: Provides performance and reliability in a compact, lightweight, and easy-to-use device

C:P2.9.text: Records up to five channels of information: respiratory effort, pulse, oxygen saturation, nasal flow and snoring

C:P2.10.text: Works seamlessly with AirView™ to provide a comprehensive sleep diagnostic solution

C:P2.11.text: † Based on average use of 8 hours per night
